title: The Combinatorial Four Color Theorem in Lean 4
abstract: A self-contained, zero-Mathlib Lean 4 formalization of the Combinatorial Four Color Theorem: every finite, complete, Euler-planar, bridgeless orientable combinatorial map (involutive hypermap, `e^2 = id`, `e ∘ n ∘ f = id`) admits a proper 4-coloring of its faces (`Solution.four_color_theorem`). Follows the published mathematics of Robertson, Sanders, Seymour, and Thomas (1996/1997) and Gonthier's hypermap framework (2008), verifying all 633 unavoidable configurations (249 D-reducible and 384 C-reducible) and all 5 cartwheel discharging trees directly inside the Lean kernel without `native_decide`.
